detailed_root_cause_explanation: In virtual-tradeshow-commercial-v1/client/internal/qa/p2r16_360_viewer.html, the resolveAndLoadTexture() function omitted currentMode.startsWith('quality-ai-r4p83-') from its 4K candidate branch due to a single-match string replacement bug in patch_viewer_r4p83.py (which only modified updateBandGeometry). As a result, when loaded in mode 'quality-ai-r4p83-selected', resolveAndLoadTexture() fell through to the default else branch, which assigned targetUrl = OTHER_MODE_URLS['quality-current'] ('P2R16_AI_QUALITY12_OWNER_REVIEW.jpg') and hardcoded targetW=4096, targetH=608. The bottom HUD displayed TEXTURE 4096x608 from this fallback, and the viewer loaded the old AI JPEG panorama rather than the true R4P8.3 artifact. The physical disk file P2R16_R4P83_SELECTED_4K.png has always been exactly 4096x623 lossless PNG.
